# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** Six past (volume 2) to around fourteen or fifteen  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c27 P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004), [v4 c15 P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053)</sub>

- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008), [v4 c15 P54](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0054)</sub>

- **Nicknames:** Mr. Davy Keith  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>; Davy-boy  <sub>[v2 c16 P3](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0003), [v2 c16 P20](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0020), [v3 c1 P34](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0034), [v3 c22 P23](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0023), [v3 c28 P9](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0009)</sub>; Master Davy  <sub>[v4 c15 P54](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0054)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a fair-complexioned lad with fuzzy yellow ringlets covering his round head, snub nose, and a single dimple in one cheek that gives him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs. His hazel eyes are described as roguish and dancing like an elf's. He has a distinct eye feature, having one blue eye and one hazel eye, which is a Moore family trait.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015)_

## Personality

Davy is energetic, curious, inquisitive, and prone to perpetual motion and mischief. Though he frequently gets into trouble, tells untruths, or resists sitting still and staying clean, he possesses a affectionate and loving heart. He adores Anne Shirley and looks up to her, frequently seeking her counsel and wanting to be praised by her. As he grows older, he shows an interest in farming and gradually settles into a smart, developing boy.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P31](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0031), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c10 P37](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0037), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052), [v3 c18 P4](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0004), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)_

## History

Following the death of his mother Mary Keith, Davy and his twin sister Dora were brought to Green Gables by Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley. At first, Davy created endless trouble through constant restlessness, pulling Dora's hair, dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, putting a toad in Marilla's bed, locking Dora in a duck-house, and telling falsehoods. Under Anne's loving influence and discipline, he developed a deep affection for her and gradually strived to be well-behaved. He attended Avonlea School, where he sat with Milty Boulter and enjoyed playing with other boys. After his uncle Richard Keith passed away, a trust fund was established for Davy and Dora, allowing them to remain permanently at Green Gables. As he grew older, he developed a strong interest in farming and sought to take over running the Green Gables farm.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c10 P45](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0045), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P23](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0023), [v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)_

## Background by volume

- His father died when he was a baby  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
- His mother, Mary Keith, was sick for a long time before dying  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>
